name: @lacspace/datacards
description: Automatic data posts from official Nepal sources — Nepal Rastra Bank forex (with day-over-day deltas), FENEGOSIDA gold/silver, Nepal Oil Corporation fuel, DHM city weather forecasts + special-bulletin alerts, Department of Environment air quality (AQI from PM2.5), and injected NEPSE — each turned into a bilingual (English/Nepali, Bikram Sambat + AD dated) @lacspace/newscard table or alert card with caption, alt text, hashtags, an optional sparkline, a worth-posting gate, and a 10–15 s montage video plan. Deterministic, bring-your-own-fetch, no AI tokens.
